sys_script.description: INACTIVE AND INTENTIONALLY SO. Three mechanisms were tested against sys_attachment from this scoped app and all three failed: setAbortAction(true) is ignored by the attachment writer; GlideRecord.deleteRecord() returns false (no scoped delete privilege); GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment() leaves the record in place. A scoped app cannot police sys_attachment on this instance. Enforcing the attachment half of the closed-engagement lock requires a GLOBAL-scope business rule or ACL, which is outside this application. The comment half IS enforced, by 'PTAG I33 - Lock comments on closed'. The portal also hides the attach control on closed records. Kept for the record; do not reactivate expecting it to work.
sys_script.name: PTAG I34 - Attachment lock (INACTIVE)
